title: How the base rate changes a positive result
learning_goal: See why a rarer condition lowers the posterior even when the test remains accurate.
inference_prompt: Move prevalence down. Which positive branch changes enough to move the posterior?
success_evidence: The learner explains the posterior using both true-positive and false-positive populations.

prediction.prompt: Before revealing the counts: if prevalence falls while the test stays the same, what happens to the posterior after a positive result?
